mostWorthwhile.text: Making connective tissue was most worthwhile: the planned sequence connects a collagen gene, messenger RNA and ribosomes to fibres that support the wound.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the new surface was predictable after the sheet had already been shown spanning the gap, although it completed the goal.

surprise.text: The capillary sprout joined another vessel to form a flow route, rather than merely growing toward the wound.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though fitting separately created parts into the wound was somewhat mechanical. The compatible menu guided these choices, so I did not discover the recipes myself.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting familiar cell biology to a physical repair outcome was interesting, especially with the qualification that young tissue is not yet as strong as uninjured skin. That is my judgment of the text and illustration plans, not evidence of student comprehension.
